newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Bucharest bourse turnover quadruples, prices mixed.
newsitem.headline: Bucharest bourse turnover quadruples, prices mixed.

text.p: The Bucharest bourse, where volumes have remained light in recent sessions, saw reinvigorated trading on Tuesday, with turnover climbing to 86.9 million lei, or more than four times the previous level.
"It was all due to renewed interest in Azomures, which traded heavily today, accounting for more than 70 percent of overall turnover," said a broker.
He said several investors had acquired larger share packages in fertiliser maker Azomures SA, seen as the most liquid of the 13 traded stocks.
Other shares were mixed and two stocks had no trade.
"There was interest in Artrom too, in which over a third of the total traded shares changed hands. Demand for other stocks was low, with investors in a waiting mood," another broker said.
Artrom SA engineering company slipped 100 lei to a close of 1,950 as supply outran demand, he said.

Investors in the Bucharest bourse seem to be waiting for the results of Sunday's presidential and parliamentary polls, as well as for results of trading on the over-the-counter (OTC) market, a trader said.
An OTC system went into operation last week and the results of the first transactions are expected by Friday.
"This waiting mood will continue throughout the week and turnover will not be as high as it was today at the coming session on Thursday," the trader said.

Two unofficial value-weighted indexes -- the VAB, computed by Vanguard SA securities, and the BIG of Bucharest Investment Group -- rose by 1.3 percent from the previous session to 290.9 points and 289.95 points respectively.
